item.title: Kim Jong-un Sends Congratulatory Message to Xi Jinping on 105th Anniversary of Chinese Communist Party Founding, "Elevating and Developing DPRK-China Relations" (김정은, 시진핑에 ‘공산당 창건 105주년’ 축전…“북중관계 승화발전”)
item.description:
Kim Jong-un Sends Congratulatory Message to Xi Jinping on 105th Anniversary of Chinese Communist Party Founding, "Elevating and Developing DPRK-China Relations" (김정은, 시진핑에 ‘공산당 창건 105주년’ 축전…“북중관계 승화발전”)

North Korean state media Korean Central News Agency reported on the 1st that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un sent a congratulatory message to Chinese President Xi Jinping on the occasion of the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 중국 공산당 창건 105주년을 맞아 시진핑 중국 국가주석에게 축전을 보냈다고 북한 조선중앙통신이 1일 보도했다.)

In his message, Kim Jong-un stated, "I am ready to continue elevating and developing the DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations, which are a common asset of the peoples of both countries, in line with the demands of the times." Kim emphasized the role of the Chinese Communist Party, saying, "The truth that there would be no new China without the Communist Party is a lesson the Chinese people have internalized while advancing alongside the Party over a long period." He further stressed the friendly relations between the two countries, adding, "Continuously strengthening and developing the DPRK-China friendly relations, which have deep historical roots and are centered on socialism, is the unwavering stance of our Party and government." <<> Regarding the DPRK-China summit held in Pyongyang on the 8th and 9th of last month, Kim Jong-un said, "The recent meeting in Pyongyang served as a historic opportunity to once again reaffirm our unwavering will to solidify comradely friendship and trust between us and to more powerfully drive forward socialist construction and traditional friendly relations in both countries." He added, "The absolute superiority of DPRK-China relations is firmly guaranteed by the leadership of the Party." <<> Kim Jong-un's sending of a congratulatory message to President Xi on the anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party's founding marks the first time in five years since the 100th anniversary in 2021. Kim has recently emphasized the strengthening bilateral relations, including sending a congratulatory message and a floral basket to President Xi on his birthday last month. <<> Yang Moo-jin, a chair professor at the University of North Korean Studies, analyzed, "In the past, when DPRK-China relations were strained, Kim Jong-un's messages were largely filled with formal phrases like 'blood alliance,' but this message, written after the Pyongyang summit last month, prominently features modern justifications such as 'the shared socialist cause and the Party's leadership.' This shows an intent to strengthen the DPRK-China socialist solidarity by supporting Xi Jinping's strategic stance of seeking long-term rule." (김정은은 축전에서 “나는 두 나라 인민들의 공동의 재부인 조중(북중) 친선 협조 관계를 시대적 요구에 맞게 계속 승화 발전시켜나갈 용의가 있다”고 말했다. 김정은은 “공산당이 없으면 새 중국도 없다는 것은 중국인민이 장구한 기간 당을 따라 전진하여오면서 체득한 진리”라면서 중국 공산당의 역할을 강조했다. 이어 “오랜 역사적 뿌리를 가지고 있고 사회주의를 핵으로 하는 조중친선관계를 끊임없이 강화 발전시켜나가는 것은 우리 당과 정부의 확고부동한 입장”이라며 양국의 친선 관계를 강조했다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do: "Strengthen Filibuster Criteria, Shorten Fast-Track Period... Will Block Opposition's Lazy Obstruction" (한병도 “필버 기준 강화·패스트트랙 기간 축소...野 태업 막겠다”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do: "Strengthen Filibuster Criteria, Shorten Fast-Track Period... Will Block Opposition's Lazy Obstruction" (한병도 “필버 기준 강화·패스트트랙 기간 축소...野 태업 막겠다”)

Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 1st that he would strengthen the criteria for applying for and maintaining a filibuster (unlimited debate) and shorten the review period for fast-track (expedited agenda processing) bills to prevent the People Power Party's political strife and obstruction. (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 필리버스터(무제한 토론) 신청·유지 기준을 강화하고, 패스스트랙(안건신속처리제도) 법안 심사 기간도 단축해 국민의힘의 정쟁과 태업을 막겠다고 1일 밝혔다.)

Acting leader Han stated during the Supreme Council meeting, "If the People Power Party feels even a shred of responsibility, they should cooperate now in electing the remaining seven standing committee chairs. If they reject even this and obstruct the National Assembly's operation, I will use all means and methods to complete the normalization of the Assembly." (한 직무대행은 이날 최고위원회의에서 “국민의힘이 일말의 책임감이라도 느낀다면 지금이라도 남은 7개 상임위원장 선출에 협조하라. 이마저도 걷어차고 국회 가동을 방해한다면 모든 수단과 방법을 동원해 국회 정상화를 완성하겠다”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

Acting leader Han said, "We will strengthen the criteria for applying for and maintaining a filibuster to ensure that even livelihood-related bills are never again taken hostage for political infighting." The Democratic Party has criticized the People Power Party for filing filibusters even against bills agreed upon by both parties and brought to plenary sessions, calling it a hindrance to people's livelihoods. Acting leader Han also added, "We will also overhaul the hollow fast-track system. The current maximum review period of 330 days is longer than the average review period for bills passed in the 21st National Assembly. We will enable truly swift legislative reviews." He further stated, "In the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, we will ensure that irresponsible political strife and obstruction have no room to take hold." <<> Meanwhile, Acting leader Han also announced the swift conclusion of the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. He said, "The floor leadership, policy committee, and members of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee will begin full-scale work on revising the Criminal Procedure Act. We will combine our wisdom to create a unified proposal and, through the intense debate and deliberation that the Democratic Party prides itself on, finalize the legislation in a short time." <<> Regarding the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections, Acting leader Han stated, "We will swiftly push forward the special counsel investigation set as party policy to uproot this incident and strictly punish those responsible." (한 직무대행은 “필리버스터 신청·유지 기준을 강화해 민생 법안조차 정쟁의 인질로 삼는 일이 다시는 반복되지 않도록 하겠다”고 했다. 그간 민주당은 국민의힘이 여야 합의로 본회의에 오른 법안까지 필리버스터를 신청하는 것은 민생 발목 잡기라고 비판해왔다. 한 직무대행은 또 “허울뿐인 패스트트랙도 손 보겠다”면서 “현행 최대 (심사 기간) 330일은 21대 국회 가결 법률안 평균 심사 기간보다 길다. 말 그대로 빠른 법안 심사가 가능하도록 하겠다”고 했다. 한 직무대행은 “22대 후반기 국회에는 무책임한 정쟁과 태업이 조금도 발붙일 수 없도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Kim Min-seok: "I will work with a greater sense of mission in a new chapter" ([속보] 김민석 “새로운 장에서 더 큰 사명감으로 뛰겠다”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Kim Min-seok: "I will work with a greater sense of mission in a new chapter" ([속보] 김민석 “새로운 장에서 더 큰 사명감으로 뛰겠다”)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 1st, "To support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration's state affairs and open a new era, I will work with a greater sense of mission in a new chapter." He also urged the public, "Please help President Lee Jae-myung, who is running for the country." (김민석 전 국무총리가 1일 “이재명 정부의 국정 성공을 뒷받침하고 새로운 시대를 열기 위해 새로운 장에서 더 큰 사명감으로 뛰겠다”고 말했다. 국민에게는 “나라를 위해 뛰고 계신 이재명 대통령님을 도와 달라”고 했다.)

Kim, who completed his term as prime minister at midnight the previous day, made these remarks during a farewell ceremony held at the Government Complex Seoul on the morning of the same day, saying, "It was an undeserved honor to warn of martial law, fight insurrection, and even take on the role of prime minister in the new government." (전날 자정으로 총리직 수행을 마친 김 전 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 열린 이임식에서 “계엄을 경고하고 내란과 싸우다 새 정부의 총리직까지 맡은 것은 과분한 영광이었다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Reflecting on the past year, the former prime minister recalled, "In the process of overcoming and recovering from the insurrection, as a prime minister, there were rewarding achievements including the success of the APEC (Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Summit in Gyeongju), attracting a global AI (Artificial Intelligence) hub, the return of medical students, clearing the administration of insurrection elements, realizing the integration of Gwangju and Jeonnam, supporting investments in Saemangeum, corporate investments in local areas, reducing suicides, and diplomatic efforts with the U.S. and China." (김 전 총리는 지난 1년에 대해 “내란 극복과 회복의 과정에서 총리 개인으로서도 APEC(경주 아시아태평양경제협력체 정상회의) 성공, 글로벌 AI(인공지능) 허브 유치, 의대생 복귀, 행정부 내란 청산, 광주·전남 통합 성사, 새만금 투자 지원, 대기업 지방 투자, 자살 감소, 미·중 외교 등 보람이 있었다”고 회고했다.)

He added, "Challenges such as improving the lives of youth and fully launching region-led growth will continue to be addressed in the party and the National Assembly." (이어 “청년의 삶 개선, 지역 주도 성장 본격화 등의 숙제는 당과 국회에서 계속 풀어가겠다”고 했다.)

The former prime minister also expressed gratitude for the dedication of public officials, saying, "I ask that you serve with even greater commitment centered around the President." To the new Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, he said, "I send my trust and support." (김 전 총리는 또 공직자들의 노고에 감사드린다며 “대통령님을 중심으로 더 치열하게 헌신해주시기를 부탁드린다”고 했다. 한성숙 신임 총리에게는 “믿음과 응원을 보낸다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I extend my sincere respect and gratitude to the citizens who are achieving all of this," and "I earnestly ask you to firmly support President Lee Jae-myung, who is running with all his heart and strength for the nation and its people." (이어 “이 모든 일을 이뤄가고 계신 국민 여러분께 진심으로 존경과 감사를 드린다”며 “전심전력으로 나라와 국민을 위해 뛰고 계신 이재명 대통령님을 굳건하게 도와주시기를 간절히 부탁드린다”고 했다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim, who took office as the first prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration on July 4 last year, served as prime minister for 362 days. Kim, who is also a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, is expected to return to the National Assembly and run for party leader in the upcoming party convention this August. (지난해 7월 4일 이재명 정부 첫 총리로 취임한 김 전 총리는 362일간 총리를 지냈다. 더불어민주당 의원이기도 한 김 전 총리는 국회로 돌아가 오는 8월 민주당 전당대회에서 당대표 선거에 출마할 것으로 전망된다.)

◇ Full Text of Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's Farewell Address (◇김민석 총리 이임사 전문)

On the day I took office, the atmosphere at the inauguration ceremony was quite serious, but today, on my last day, the mood seems very good. I must make sure to inform the incoming prime minister that the day the prime minister steps down might be the best day for the Prime Minister's Office. That gave me pause. A little while ago, I saw that the prime minister signs a resignation letter at the end. So I thought about refusing to resign, about stalling, but here I am. (제가 취임하는 날 취임식 때는 다들 분위기가 심각했는데, 이임하는 날 분위기가 너무 좋은 것 같습니다. 총리가 그만두는 날 총리실 분위기가 제일 좋을 수 있다는 것을 제가 후임 총리께 꼭 알려드려야겠습니다. 제가 그래서 고민했습니다. 조금 전에 보니까 국무총리가 마지막에 사직원에 서명하는 게 있더라고요. 그래서 사직 거부를 해볼까, 시간을 끌어볼까 하다가 이렇게 왔습니다.)

Respected citizens, esteemed public officials of the people's sovereign government, I am leaving the post of Prime Minister today and returning to the party and the National Assembly. I was nominated on the day the new government was launched and have completed my one-year mission. (존경하는 국민 여러분, 국민주권정부의 공직자 여러분, 저는 오늘 국무총리직을 떠나 당과 국회로 돌아갑니다. 새 정부 출범 당일 지명돼 1년의 임무를 마쳤습니다.)

It was an undeserved honor to warn of martial law, fight insurrection, and even take on the role of prime minister in the new government. I am deeply indebted to the people and the President. (계엄을 경고하고, 내란과 싸우다 새 정부의 총리직까지 맡은 것은 과분한 영광이었습니다. 국민 여러분과 대통령님께 참으로 큰 은혜를 입었습니다.)

In the process of overcoming and recovering from the insurrection, as a prime minister, there were rewarding achievements including the success of APEC, attracting a global AI hub, the return of medical students, clearing the administration of insurrection elements, realizing the integration of Gwangju and Jeonnam, supporting investments in Saemangeum, corporate investments in local areas, reducing suicides, and diplomatic efforts with the U.S. and China. (내란 극복과 회복의 과정에 총리 개인으로서도 APEC 성공, 글로벌 AI 허브 유치, 의대생 복귀, 행정부 내란 청산, 광주·전남 통합 성사, 새만금 투자 지원, 대기업 지방 투자, 자살 감소, 미·중 외교 등 보람이 있었습니다.)

Challenges such as improving the lives of youth and fully launching region-led growth will continue to be addressed in the party and the National Assembly. (청년의 삶 개선, 지역 주도 성장 본격화 등의 숙제는 당과 국회에서 계속 풀어가겠습니다.)

I thank the public officials of the government, including those in the Prime Minister's Office, for their hard work. I ask that you serve with even greater commitment centered around the President. I also send my trust and support to the excellent incoming Prime Minister. (총리실을 비롯한 정부 공직자 여러분의 노고에 감사드립니다. 대통령님을 중심으로 더 치열하게 헌신해주시길 부탁드립니다. 훌륭하신 후임 총리께도 믿음과 응원을 보냅니다.)

I believe politics is about seeing the future through the eyes of the weak. On the sheep-patterned tie of the Prime Minister's Office that I am wearing, the spot for one sheep in the middle is empty. It is an expression of my resolve to not miss anyone and to care for everyone in the process of recovery, growth, and leap forward. I ask that you continue to uphold the attitude of public officials in the Lee Jae-myung administration, which prioritizes the people, life, and the weak. (저는 약자의 눈으로 미래를 보는 것이 정치라고 생각합니다. 제가 메고 있는 양 무늬의 국무총리실 넥타이에는 가운데 한 마리 양의 자리가 비어 있습니다. 회복과 성장과 도약의 과정에서 단 한 사람도 놓치지 말고 살피고 챙기자는 다짐의 표현입니다. 앞으로도 국민과 생명과 약자를 최우선으로 하는 이재명 정부 공직자의 자세를 지켜 주시기를 부탁드립니다.)

The history we are creating today, together with the people and the Lee Jae-myung administration following the Revolution of Light, will be the prelude to a golden age in our 5,000-year history. (빛의 혁명 이후 국민 여러분과 이재명 정부가 함께 열어 가고 있는 오늘의 역사는 5000년 우리 역사의 황금 시대로 가는 서막이 될 것입니다.)

I extend my sincere respect and gratitude to the citizens who are achieving all of this. And I earnestly ask you to firmly support President Lee Jae-myung, who is running with all his heart and strength for the nation and its people. (이 모든 일을 이뤄 가고 계신 국민 여러분께 진심으로 존경과 감사를 드립니다. 그리고 전심전력으로 나라와 국민을 위해 뛰고 계신 이재명 대통령님을 굳건하게 도와주시길 간절히 부탁드립니다.)

To support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration's state affairs and open a new era, I will work with a greater sense of mission in a new chapter. Thank you. (이재명 정부의 국정 성공을 뒷받침하고 새로운 시대를 열기 위해 새로운 장에서 더 큰 사명감으로 뛰겠습니다. 감사합니다.)

item.title: Ruling Party to Support Government’s ‘Three Mega Projects’... Launches Internal Task Force (與, 정부 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’ 지원...당내 TF 출범)
item.description:
Ruling Party to Support Government’s ‘Three Mega Projects’... Launches Internal Task Force (與, 정부 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’ 지원...당내 TF 출범)

The Democratic Party of Korea has decided to establish a task force (TF) to support the ‘Three Mega Projects for Korea’s Great Leap Forward,’ including semiconductor investments worth 800 trillion won in the Honam region. (더불어민주당이 800조원 규모의 호남 반도체 투자를 비롯한 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가 프로젝트’를 지원하는 태스크포스(TF)를 꾸리기로 했다.)

Kang Joon-hyun, the senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting on the 1st, “We have decided to launch a provisional ‘Three Mega Projects Support TF.’” The TF will be chaired by Han Jeong-ae, the head of the Policy Committee, with members comprising the senior deputy head of the Policy Committee, the senior deputy floor leader, and the secretaries of the relevant standing committees. (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 1일 최고위원회의 직후 기자들과 만나 “가칭 ‘3대 메가프로젝트 지원 TF’를 출범하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. TF 위원장은 한정애 정책위의장이 맡고, 위원은 정책위 수석부의장과 원내수석부대표, 담당 상임위 간사위원으로 꾸려진다.)

Senior spokesperson Kang stated, “The three mega projects are a feast meticulously prepared by the government and businesses for the future livelihood and balanced development of the Republic of Korea,” adding, “A joint TF of relevant ministries has been formed, and a dedicated team has also been set up within the presidential office. In response, the Democratic Party is launching a support TF.” (강 수석대변인은 “3대 메가프로젝트는 대한민국 미래 먹거리와 균형 발전을 위해 정부, 기업이 정성껏 차린 잔칫상”이라면서 “관계부처 합동 TF가 구성됐고, 청와대 내 전담팀도 구성됐다. 이에 부응해 민주당도 지원 TF를 출범한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the People Power Party’s criticism of the 800 trillion won semiconductor investment in Honam as ‘hasty promotion’ and its mention of a parliamentary inspection, Senior Spokesperson Kang said, “This goes beyond simply complaining about side dishes to threatening to ‘overturn the table if necessary.’” He added, “Achieving a super gap in semiconductors is ultimately a race against time. If the People Power Party continues to obstruct, they will not escape public criticism.” (강 수석대변인은 국민의힘이 호남 800조 반도체 투자를 ‘졸속 추진’이라고 비판하면서 국정조사 등을 거론한 데 대해서는 “단순히 반찬 투정하는 수준을 넘어서 ‘여차하면 상을 엎겠다’는 겁박”이라고 했다. 강 수석대변인은 “반도체 초격차는 결국 시간 싸움”이라면서 “국민의힘이 끝까지 발목을 잡으면 국민의 질타를 결코 피할 수 없을 것”이라고 했다.)

The government recently announced the ‘Three Mega Projects’ worth thousands of trillions of won. Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and others plan to invest astronomical sums in industries such as semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI to secure future growth engines. This includes building four new memory factories in Honam through investments of 800 trillion won and establishing AI data centers worth 550 trillion won in the Yeongnam and Chungcheong regions. (정부는 최근 수천조 원 규모의 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’를 발표했다. 삼성전자, SK하이닉스 등이 반도체, AI 데이터센터, 피지컬AI 등 산업에 천문학적 규모로 투자해 미래 성장 동력을 확보하겠다는 것이다. 호남에 800조원 규모의 투자를 통해 신규 메모리 공장 4기를 짓고, 영남과 충청권 등에 550조원 규모의 AI 데이터센터를 구축하는 등의 내용이다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "Current Military Academies Fail to Give Vision to Outstanding Talent... Fundamental Reform Urgent" (안규백 “지금의 사관학교, 우수 인재에게 비전 못 줘… 근본 개혁 시급")
item.description:
Ahn Gyu-baek: "Current Military Academies Fail to Give Vision to Outstanding Talent... Fundamental Reform Urgent" (안규백 “지금의 사관학교, 우수 인재에게 비전 못 줘… 근본 개혁 시급")

Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-baek stated on the 1st regarding the government's push to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, "The current military academies fail to give outstanding talent the confidence that they can unfold their vision and potential." (안규백 국방부 장관이 정부가 추진하는 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합과 관련해 “지금의 사관학교가 우수한 인재들에게 자신의 비전과 잠재력을 펼칠 수 있다는 확신을 주지 못한다”고 1일 말했다.)

Minister Ahn made these remarks during the 'First Half of 2026 Major Military Commanders' Meeting' held under his leadership on the same day. (안 장관은 이날 자신의 주관으로 열린 ‘2026년 전반기 전군 주요 지휘관 회의’에서 이같이 말했다.)

The core of the government's military academy integration plan is to merge the existing Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into a single 'National Military Academy.' Under the '2+2 system,' freshmen and sophomores at the National Military Academy would receive common foundational education, while juniors and seniors would specialize by service branch for advanced coursework. The Ministry of National Defense plans to announce the final proposal as early as this month. (정부의 사관학교 통합안은 기존 육·해·공군 사관학교를 합쳐 ‘국군 사관학교’를 만드는 것이 핵심이다. 국군 사관학교 1~2학년은 공통 기초 소양을 같이 교육받고, 3~4학년은 육·해·공군을 나눠 전공 심화 과정을 다루는 ‘2+2 방식’이다. 국방부는 이르면 이달 최종안을 발표할 예정이다.)

Minister Ahn stated, "The military academies should no longer remain merely as institutions that produce elite officers for each service branch," adding, "The type of talent the times demand is changing." He further remarked, "If we fail to cultivate officers capable of designing drone battlefields and conceptualizing AI-based operational systems, we cannot guarantee the future of our military beyond 2040." (안 장관은 “이제 사관학교는 각 군의 정예 장교를 길러내는 곳에 머물러서는 안 된다”며 “시대가 요구하는 인재상이 달라지고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “드론 전장을 설계하고, 인공지능(AI) 기반 작전 체계를 구상할 수 있는 장교, 그런 인재를 지금 길러내지 않으면, 2040년 이후 우리 군의 미래를 장담할 수 없다”고 했다.)

He continued, "But what is our reality? Entrance exam scores for the military academies are continuously declining," emphasizing, "Fundamental reform of the academies' vision and goals, faculty, facilities and infrastructure, and educational curriculum is urgently needed." (그러면서 “그러나 우리의 현실은 어떤가. 사관학교 입학 성적은 계속 낮아지고 있다”며 “사관학교 교육의 비전과 목표, 교수진, 시설 및 인프라, 교육 커리큘럼 등의 근본적 개혁이 시급하다”고 했다.)

Minister Ahn said, "Each service branch's expertise must be preserved. However, that expertise should not become a silo." He added, "Jointness is not something we need to strengthen further; it is something we must now internalize as a core characteristic. And that characteristic does not develop naturally in the field." (안 장관은 “각 군의 전문성은 반드시 지켜져야 한다. 그러나 그 전문성이 칸막이가 되어서는 안 된다”라며 “합동성은 강화해 나가야 하는 게 아니라, 이제는 체질화해야 한다. 그리고 그 체질은 야전에서 저절로 길러지지 않는다”고 했다.)

He elaborated, "Jointness must first be internalized through a process of learning together, training together, and thinking together starting from the military academies, and then refined and evolved further in the field." (그러면서 “합동성은 사관학교에서부터 함께 배우고, 함께 훈련하고, 함께 생각하는 과정을 통해 체질화시킨 후에, 야전에서 더 다듬고 진화시켜 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

At the meeting, Minister Ahn identified the 'transition of wartime operational control (OPCON)' and 'reform of counterintelligence and intelligence agencies' as key military reform tasks alongside the integration of military academies. (안 장관은 이날 회의에서 사관학교 통합과 함께 핵심적인 군 개혁 과제로 ‘전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환’과 ‘방첩·정보 기관 개혁’을 꼽았다.)

Minister Ahn stated, "Recovering wartime OPCON is more than a formula for self-reliant defense; it is a path to building a stronger Republic of Korea and advancing the ROK-US alliance to the next level." He added, "Once we recover wartime OPCON, our military will fully lead everything from wartime planning and operational design to execution, which will unleash the capabilities and potential we have built up over the years." (안 장관은 “전작권 회복은 자주국방이라는 수식을 넘어 더 강한 대한민국을 만들고, 한미동맹을 한 차원 더 진화시키는 길”이라며 “전작권을 회복하면 우리 군은 전시기획부터 계획수립, 작전수행까지를 온전히 주도하게 되고, 이는 우리 군이 그동안 쌓아온 역량과 잠재력을 폭발시킬 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the reform of counterintelligence and intelligence agencies, he said, "Missions that lack clear legal basis or have potential for illegality must be fundamentally abolished, and the organizations must be completely restructured around functions." He stressed, "We must put institutional locks in place so that, no matter what unjust power emerges, counterintelligence agencies cannot be abused as political tools." (방첩·정보 기관 개혁과 관련해서는 “법령상 근거가 명확하지 않거나, 불법의 소지가 있는 임무를 원천적으로 폐지하고, 기능 중심으로 조직을 전면 재구성해야 한다”며 “어떠한 부당한 권력이 등장하더라도 방첩기관을 정치적 도구로 악용할 수 없도록 제도적 빗장을 걸어야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Floor Leader Jung Points-sik Puts Brake on Jang Dong-hyuk's "Disciplinary Card"..."Disciplining Lawmakers Should Be Handled with Caution" (정점식, 장동혁 ‘징계 카드’에 제동…“의원 징계는 신중해야”)
item.description:
Floor Leader Jung Points-sik Puts Brake on Jang Dong-hyuk's "Disciplinary Card"..."Disciplining Lawmakers Should Be Handled with Caution" (정점식, 장동혁 ‘징계 카드’에 제동…“의원 징계는 신중해야”)

People Power Party Floor Leader Jung Points-sik stated on the 1st regarding the party's Central Ethics Committee initiating disciplinary review procedures against individuals with anti-Jang Dong-hyuk tendencies that "disciplinary actions against lawmakers should be carried out cautiously." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 1일 당 중앙윤리위원회가 반(反)장동혁 성향 인사들에 대한 징계 심의 절차에 착수한 데 대해 “의원들에 대한 징계는 신중하게 진행돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk had hinted at disciplinary action, citing acts harmful to the party during the June 3 local elections, and the Central Ethics Committee is reportedly set to deliberate disciplinary proposals against about ten lawmakers on the 6th. In response, Floor Leader Jung has stepped in to put the brakes on the matter by raising the need for caution on discipline. (앞서 장동혁 대표는 6·3 지방선거 과정에서 해당(害黨) 행위가 있었다며 징계를 시사했고, 중앙윤리위는 오는 6일 의원 10여 명에 대한 징계안 심의에 나설 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 대해 정 원내대표가 ‘징계 신중론’을 제기하면서 제동을 걸고 나선 것이다.)

When asked by reporters about the convening of the Ethics Committee on the same day, Floor Leader Jung stated, "It has only been announced, and there is no decision yet on how the disciplinary process will actually proceed, so it's difficult to give a specific answer now," while adding, "I do say that disciplinary actions against our lawmakers should be handled with caution." (정 원내대표는 이날 기자들과 만나 윤리위 소집과 관련한 질문에 “아직 예고만 됐을 뿐 실제로 징계 절차가 어떻게 진행될지는 결정된 바가 없기 때문에 지금 뭐라고 답변 드리기 어렵다”면서도 “우리 의원님들에 대한 징계는 신중하게 진행돼야 한다는 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won, classified as part of the ruling faction, commented on the Ethics Committee's disciplinary move, saying, "We need to make efforts to ensure it doesn't escalate to the point where the party is thrown into chaos." (당권파로 분류되는 김재원 최고위원은 이날 윤리위의 징계 움직임에 대해 “당이 혼란에 휩싸이는 그런 정도로 가지 않도록 노력을 해야 될 것”이라고 했다.)

On YTN Radio that day, Supreme Council member Kim said, "It is just and necessary to enforce party discipline against those who violate the party constitution and rules, but if mismanagement afterward leads to intensified factional strife, then proper management is needed." (김 최고위원은 이날 YTN라디오에서 “당헌·당규를 위반한 사람에 대해서 기강을 세우는 당무 수행은 정당하고 필요하지만, 그 후에 관리 잘못으로 인해서 분란이 강화된다면 그 관리를 제대로 하는 것이 좀 필요하다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Ethics Committee's upcoming disciplinary deliberation, there are murmurs within the party that it may target lawmakers who helped independent candidate Han Dong-hoon in the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, with speculation that "the top priority for discipline will be the pro-Han faction." (윤리위의 이번 징계안 심의를 두고 당내에선 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 무소속 한동훈 의원을 도운 의원들을 징계하려는 것 아니냐며 “징계 대상 1순위는 친한계일 것”이라는 말이 나오고 있다.)

item.title: From Prime Minister to Parliament: Kim Min-seok's First Day Back, a War of Nerves Over the Party Leadership Election Schedule (총리에서 국회로 김민석 복귀 첫날, 당 대표 선거 일정 두고도 신경전)
item.description:
From Prime Minister to Parliament: Kim Min-seok's First Day Back, a War of Nerves Over the Party Leadership Election Schedule (총리에서 국회로 김민석 복귀 첫날, 당 대표 선거 일정 두고도 신경전)

With Kim Min-seok, the Prime Minister being mentioned as a candidate for the next leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stepping down from his post on the 1st and returning to the National Assembly, the race for party leadership is heating up. As competitors, including former leader Jeong Cheong-rae and lawmaker Song Young-gil, also prepare to launch their campaigns, issues have been raised regarding the schedule for the party convention's regional primaries, signaling an early war of nerves within the Democratic Party's convention. (더불어민주당 차기 당 대표 출마가 거론되는 김민석 국무총리가 1일 총리직에서 물러나 국회로 복귀하면서 당권 경쟁도 본격화하고 있다. 정청래 전 대표와 송영길 의원 등 경쟁 주자들도 출마 채비에 들어간 가운데, 전당대회 순회 경선 일정을 둘러싼 문제 제기까지 나오면서 민주당 전당대회는 초반부터 신경전 양상을 보이고 있다.)

Prime Minister Kim returned to the National Assembly on the morning of the 1st after a farewell ceremony at the Government Seoul Complex. He is expected to minimize public engagements and focus on preparing for the party convention by contacting lawmakers. Lawmakers Yeom Tae-young, Hwang Myeong-seon, and Yoon Jong-gun have reportedly joined Kim's camp, with lawmaker Lee Yong-woo set to serve as spokesperson. As Kim transitions from the prime ministership to a party leadership contender, his return is seen as ushering in the full-fledged competition for the Democratic Party convention. (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 이임식을 마친 뒤 국회로 돌아왔다. 공개 일정은 최소화한 채 의원들과 접촉하며 전당대회 준비에 들어갈 것으로 알려졌다. 김 총리 측에는 염태영·황명선·윤종군 의원 등이 합류했고, 이용우 의원이 대변인 역할을 맡을 예정이다. 총리직을 마친 직후 당권 주자로 전환하는 만큼, 김 총리의 복귀는 민주당 전당대회 구도가 본격적으로 열리는 계기로 받아들여진다.)

The war of nerves first erupted over the schedule for the regional primaries of the party convention. The Democratic Party's Convention Preparation Committee held its first meeting on the 30th of last month to discuss the schedule for regional primaries. According to the committee's proposal, the regional primaries will begin on the 1st of next month in South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Daejeon, and Sejong, followed by Ulsan, Busan, and South Gyeongsang on the 2nd; Jeju and Incheon on the 8th; Gangwon, Daegu, and North Gyeongsang on the 9th; North Jeolla, South Jeolla, and Gwangju on the 15th; and Gyeonggi and Seoul on the 16th. (신경전은 전당대회 순회 경선 일정을 두고 먼저 불거지고 있다. 민주당 전당대회준비위원회는 지난달 30일 1차 회의를 열고 시도당 순회 경선 일정을 논의했다. 전준위 안에 따르면 순회 경선은 다음 달 1일 충남·충북·대전·세종을 시작으로, 2일 울산·부산·경남, 8일 제주·인천, 9일 강원·대구·경북, 15일 전북·전남·광주, 16일 경기·서울 순으로 진행된다.)

Sources say that Kim's camp and Song's camp have expressed dissatisfaction, suggesting that this schedule might favor former leader Jeong. This is because the first primary region is set in Chungcheong, Jeong's home region, while the Honam primary—which has a large proportion of party members and is considered a key battleground for the leadership race—is scheduled for the later stages. (김 총리 측과 송 의원 측에서는 이 일정이 정 전 대표에게 유리한 것 아니냐는 불만이 제기된 것으로 알려졌다. 첫 경선 지역이 정 전 대표의 출신지인 충청권으로 잡힌 반면, 권리당원 비중이 크고 당권 경쟁의 핵심 승부처로 꼽히는 호남 경선은 후반부로 배치됐다는 이유에서다.)

An aide from Kim's camp told the Chosun Ilbo on the 1st, "If the Honam primary results come out early, it will inevitably affect the overall flow of the party convention," adding, "There are concerns about the background behind the Honam schedule being pushed back." Another party official remarked, "There are criticisms that the schedule was finalized without sufficiently hearing the positions of the candidate camps." (김 총리 측 관계자는 이날 조선일보에 “호남 경선 결과가 초반에 나오면 전체 전당대회 흐름에 영향을 줄 수밖에 없다”며 “호남 일정이 뒤로 밀린 배경에 문제의식이 있다”고 말했다. 다른 당 관계자도 “후보 캠프들의 입장을 충분히 듣지 않은 상태에서 일정이 먼저 정리된 것 아니냐는 지적이 있다”고 했다.)

The Convention Preparation Committee maintains that there was no intention to favor any specific candidate. A committee official explained, "The members each expressed their opinions, and we coordinated these to finalize the schedule," adding, "We also had to consider venue bookings and practical preparations for each region." (전준위 측은 특정 후보에게 유리한 의도는 없었다는 입장이다. 전준위 관계자는 “위원들이 각자 의견을 개진했고 이를 조정해 일정을 정리한 것”이라며 “지역별 장소 대관과 실무 준비 상황도 함께 고려해야 한다”고 설명했다.)

However, this issue was also discussed during the Democratic Party's Supreme Council meeting on the 1st. Lawmaker Kang Joon-hyun, speaking to reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, addressed the controversy over the regional primary schedule, stating, "This was not a matter for a vote but a report to the Supreme Council on the committee's decision. There were opinions. Not disagreements, but opinions." (다만 이 문제는 이날 민주당 최고위원회의 비공개 논의에서도 다뤄졌다. 강준현 민주당 의원은 최고위 뒤 기자들과 만나 순회 경선 일정 논란에 대해 “이건 의결 사항이 아니고 전준위 결정을 최고위에 보고한 것”이라며 “의견이 있었다. 이견이 아니고 의견이 있었다”고 했다.)

Kang continued, "I understand that the meeting has resumed, and discussions are ongoing," adding, "There can be opinions on issues like venue or booking problems." (강 의원은 이어 “그래서 속개해서 지금 논의하고 있는 것으로 안다”며 “장소 문제라든가 대관 문제라든가 그런 의견들이 있을 수 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "I believe the Committee and the Supreme Council will coordinate well and come up with a reasonable plan," and "We will announce it when it's ready." This suggests that the schedule proposed by the Committee has not been finalized and may still be subject to adjustment. (그러면서 “전준위와 최고위가 잘 조율해서 합리적인 방안이 나올 것이라고 생각한다”며 “또 발표되면 말씀드리겠다”고 했다. 전준위가 마련한 일정안이 최종 확정된 것은 아니며, 조정 가능성이 남아 있음을 시사한 것이다.)

The Democratic Party plans to accept candidate registrations for party leader and Supreme Council members on the 16th and 17th, with a preliminary primary scheduled for the 21st. Discussions are underway for the regional primaries to be held over three weeks starting on the 1st of next month. The party has noted that the detailed schedule may change depending on venue availability. (민주당은 당대표 및 최고위원 후보 등록을 오는 16∼17일 진행하고, 21일 예비경선을 치를 예정이다. 시도당 순회 경선은 다음 달 1일부터 3주간 진행하는 방안이 논의되고 있다. 당은 세부 일정의 경우 장소 대관 사정 등에 따라 변경될 수 있다고 설명했다.)

Former leader Jeong had no separate public schedule on the 1st. Lawmaker Song is also preparing for his party leadership bid while continuing his legislative activities. With Kim's return to the National Assembly making the three-way contest for party leadership more visible, and the issue of the regional primary schedule adding to the tension, the Democratic Party convention appears to have entered a battle for dominance even before candidate registration begins. (정 전 대표는 이날 별도 공개 일정을 잡지 않았다. 송 의원도 국회 활동을 병행하며 당권 행보를 준비하고 있다. 김 전 총리의 국회 복귀로 당권 경쟁의 세 축이 가시화되는 가운데, 순회 경선 일정 문제까지 겹치면서 민주당 전당대회는 후보 등록 전부터 주도권 경쟁에 들어간 모습이다.)

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is reported to have had private meetings with lawmakers at the National Assembly on the 1st and is expected to have dinner with senior advisors of the Democratic Party, including Kwon Roh-kap and Moon Hee-sang. (이런 가운데 김민석 총리는 이날 국회에서 의원들과 비공개 접촉을 한 이후 권노갑, 문희상 등 민주당 상임고문들과 만찬을 할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Croaker Soup and Bibimbap on the Menu for First Blue House Luncheon with Lee and Moon (李-文 첫 靑오찬에 민어탕·비빔밥 오른다)
item.description:
Croaker Soup and Bibimbap on the Menu for First Blue House Luncheon with Lee and Moon (李-文 첫 靑오찬에 민어탕·비빔밥 오른다)

President Lee Jae-myung will welcome former President Moon Jae-in to the Blue House on the 1st, sharing croaker soup and bibimbap. The Blue House described the meal as a 'table of unity.' President Lee will also hold a dinner with the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea that evening. (이재명 대통령이 1일 문재인 전 대통령을 청와대로 초청해 민어탕과 비빔밥 등을 함께한다. 청와대는 ‘통합의 밥상’이라고 설명했다. 이 대통령은 이날 저녁에는 더불어민주당 원내대표단과도 만찬을 한다.)

According to the Blue House, President Lee will have a luncheon meeting with former President Moon at the Blue House at 11:30 a.m. that day. This is the first official meeting at the Blue House since President Lee took office. The Blue House stated that the luncheon menu was centered on summer health foods, reflecting former President Moon's preference for seafood and fish, as well as President Lee's tastes from his hometown of Andong. In particular, it was explained that the food embodies the meaning of 'harmony' and 'unity' emphasized by both the current and former presidents. <<> Before the meal, a welcoming tea session will be held with Korean traditional sweets such as Gaeseong juak, samsaek maejakgwa, sagwa jeonggwa, and bae jeonggwa, along with jujube tea. This will be followed by a starter of suranchae, an Andong head family dish, then green bean samgyetang with free-range chicken and ginseng, and a set of jeon featuring flounder, a seasonal fish from the South Sea that former President Moon enjoys, along with cabbage jeon favored by President Lee. The main course will be grilled premium hanwoo galbi-jjim, and for the meal, croaker soup, a summer health food former President Moon likes, and bibimbap, symbolizing unity with its mix of various ingredients, will be served. <<> For dessert, an assortment of rice cakes with a blend of flavors and fruit hwachae will be prepared. The Blue House explained regarding the hwachae, "It was prepared in memory of First Lady Kim Jung-sook making hwachae with fallen fruit from flood-hit areas in 2017 and offering it to Blue House staff and reporters." <<> The meeting is expected to involve broad discussions on overall state affairs, including livelihoods, the economy, diplomacy and security, as well as measures for national unity. It is also anticipated that there will be conversations about internal party unity and stable state management ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention next month. <<> Hong Ik-pyo, Senior Secretary for Political Affairs at the Blue House, stated on Facebook, "It will be a meaningful occasion to listen to the former president's insights and have candid discussions on overall state affairs for the recovery of livelihoods, national unity, and the success of a government of the people." Yoon Geon-young, a Democratic Party lawmaker classified as a close aide to former President Moon, also posted on Facebook, "I remember past times when their meeting helped the party overcome a crisis," and "I sincerely hope their meeting becomes an opportunity to break through the current situation." <<> President Lee will also invite the leadership team of the Democratic Party, including Han Byeong-do, acting party leader and floor leader, to the Blue House for dinner that evening. This is the first such gathering since the launch of the third-term leadership for the 22nd National Assembly, and President Lee will receive briefings on the formation of the second half of the 22nd National Assembly and discuss key legislative tasks for the provisional session this month, livelihood bills, and ways to strengthen party-government cooperation. (청와대에 따르면 이 대통령은 이날 오전 11시 30분 청와대에서 문 전 대통령과 오찬 회동을 한다. 이 대통령 취임 이후 청와대에서 이뤄지는 첫 공식 회동이다. 청와대는 이날 오찬 메뉴를 해산물과 생선을 좋아하는 문 전 대통령의 취향과 안동이 고향인 이 대통령의 기호를 반영한 여름 보양식 중심으로 구성했다고 밝혔다. 특히 두 전·현직 대통령이 강조해온 ‘화합’과 ‘통합’의 의미를 음식에 담았다고 설명했다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook: “We Will Create a Government That Moves Quickly” (한성숙 “빠르게 움직이는 정부 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Han Sung-sook: “We Will Create a Government That Moves Quickly” (한성숙 “빠르게 움직이는 정부 만들겠다”)

Newly appointed Prime Minister Han Sung-sook stated on the 1st, “Our country’s status is shifting to one that leads major transformations,” and added, “The government will also move swiftly in line with this, and I will do my utmost to ensure that necessary policies are implemented in a timely manner.” Regarding the approval of the appointment motion by the ruling party alone, despite the People Power Party raising objections of “unsuitability,” she commented, “I recall that during the confirmation hearing, everyone applauded.” <<> After receiving her appointment letter from President Lee Jae-myung at the Yongsan Presidential Office at 10 a.m. that day, Prime Minister Han arrived at the Government Complex Seoul about 40 minutes later and made these remarks while meeting with reporters. <<> Han mentioned the government’s recent announcement of the “Three Mega Projects for Korea’s Great Leap Forward,” including a 800 trillion won-scale investment in the Honam semiconductor sector, calling it “a day when a milestone was set, changing the scale and pace of our industrial and balanced development beyond what we had ever imagined.” <<> She further stated, “The government will also adjust to this and move quickly,” adding, “We will be more bold in investments in AI (artificial intelligence) and advanced industries, and actively pursue the rationalization of regulations that could become obstacles to innovation.” She also pledged, “I will strive to ensure that these achievements permeate the lives of the people.” <<> When asked, “What do you consider your first task?” Han replied, “The speed of the government is extremely important,” and said, “I will do my best to make the government move more quickly.” <<> Despite the People Power Party expressing an opinion of “unsuitability” during the parliamentary confirmation hearing, Han was able to assume the role of prime minister after the ruling party unilaterally processed the appointment approval motion the previous day. Regarding this, Han remarked, “Since it’s a matter handled by the National Assembly, it doesn’t seem appropriate for me to comment.” Nonetheless, she added, “I recall that everyone applauded during the hearing,” and said, “I will do well, buoyed by that encouragement.” <<> In response to the question, “What do you see as the role of the prime minister?” Han reframed it as “Why Han Sung-sook at this point in time.” She explained, “This is a time when the public and private sectors must move forward together, and in that regard, the intent is for me—someone who understands both industry and the language of the public sector—to lead the government.” <<> Regarding becoming the second female prime minister in constitutional history, Han said, “I haven’t thought much about that,” and added, “I believe it happened simply because I became eligible for this position.” (한성숙 신임 국무총리가 1일 “우리나라가 대격변을 주도하는 나라로 위상이 변하고 있다”며 “정부도 여기에 맞춰 발 빠르게 움직이고 필요한 정책이 제때 실행되도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다. 국민의힘이 ‘부적격’ 의견을 낸 가운데 여권 단독으로 임명 동의안이 통과된 것에 대해서는 “인사청문회에서 모두가 박수쳐준 것으로 기억한다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Jeolla Protests as Investment Centers on Gwangju and South Jeolla… Concerns Over Democratic Party’s Dominance Across Honam (광주·전남 중심 투자에 전북 반발…호남 곳곳서 민주당 독주 우려 목소리)
item.description:
North Jeolla Protests as Investment Centers on Gwangju and South Jeolla… Concerns Over Democratic Party’s Dominance Across Honam (광주·전남 중심 투자에 전북 반발…호남 곳곳서 민주당 독주 우려 목소리)

Resistance is growing in North Jeolla Province over the “Southwestern Semiconductor Investment Plan” announced by the government, Samsung Electronics, and SK Hynix. While massive investments are concentrated in Gwangju and South Jeolla, North Jeolla is excluded from direct industrial attraction and could end up bearing only the burden of transmission grid expansion. <<> In the Gwangju/South Jeolla and North Jeolla provincial councils, voices from minority parties are increasingly criticizing the way the majority Democratic Party runs the councils. The Progressive Party and others have raised concerns about the Democratic Party’s dominance in issues such as the allocation of semiconductor investments, the formation of council leadership, and the processing of ordinances. <<> On the 1st, the North Jeolla Provincial Party of the Progressive Party issued a statement criticizing the government’s southwestern semiconductor investment plan, calling it “a decision that crushes expectations for balanced national development” and “a measure that effectively turns North Jeolla into an isolated region.” <<> The North Jeolla Provincial Party argued that the plan “concentrates enormous investment in South Jeolla and Gwangju, but only increases the number of transmission towers in North Jeolla.” It further pointed out, “This is no different from reducing North Jeolla to a ‘power supply base,’ and directly contradicts the government’s stated policy direction emphasizing responses to local extinction and balanced development.” <<> The investment plan is worth approximately 800 trillion won and focuses on building a semiconductor industry base in the Gwangju/South Jeolla region. However, concerns are emerging that while North Jeolla is excluded from direct industrial attraction, it may face an increased burden of transmission infrastructure to supply power to the Seoul metropolitan area semiconductor complexes. <<> The Democratic Party’s North Jeolla Provincial Party argued that, despite North Jeolla possessing favorable conditions for the semiconductor industry—such as a renewable energy base (RE100), expansive industrial sites, and a stable water supply—it was excluded from the policy decision process. They proposed the distributed placement of a Honam region semiconductor cluster including North Jeolla, the formation of a cross-party “Pan-North Jeolla Residents Promotion Body,” and the convening of an emergency joint meeting of the three parties in the Honam region. <<> Criticism also targeted the local political establishment. The North Jeolla Provincial Party stated, “Despite producing numerous lawmakers and ministers, [the political circle] has failed to show any presence on key regional issues, essentially maintaining a consistent silence.” They added, “Failing to respond to an issue that concerns the region’s very survival goes beyond dereliction of duty.” <<> Concerns about the Democratic Party’s dominance were also raised in local councils. <<> On the 1st, the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City Council held its first plenary session of the first extraordinary meeting at midnight to process essential autonomous legislation related to the council, the city, and the education office. This was a measure to prevent a vacuum in the council and administration immediately after the launch of the unified special city. <<> The executive branch initially sought to process 463 ordinance bills, but the number of items processed on the first day was reduced to 233 after council members argued they lacked sufficient time to carefully review the ordinances. <<> Before processing the agenda, Assembly Speaker Song Hyeong-gon, who was elected that day, cited the special circumstances of the unified special city’s launch, the need to prevent a council and administrative vacuum immediately after the launch, and prior reviews conducted through briefings, orientations, and a body of elected members. He announced that proceedings would be conducted by directly tabling items in the plenary session, providing a collective explanation of proposals by sector, and conducting block voting. <<> However, the deliberation process in the plenary session mostly moved straight to voting on items without questions or debate. While Democratic Party lawmakers, the majority party, provided explanations for the proposals for Ordinance No. 1—the Semiconductor Strategic Investment Support Ordinance and ordinances related to council operations—they did not engage in pro-con debates on the key issues of individual ordinances. <<> Critics pointed out that, in the first unified council convened to review ordinances in advance, the Democratic Party focused on passing the agenda items presented by the executive and the speaker’s office without open questions or debate. This meant more weight was placed on processing the launch procedures than on the council’s checks-and-balances and deliberation functions. <<> In contrast, lawmakers from the Progressive Party engaged in open opposition debates on some contentious ordinances. <<> Progressive Party lawmaker Yoon Min-ho stood as an opposition debater against the “Ordinance on the Formation and Operation of Parliamentary Negotiation Groups and Committees,” taking issue with the procedure for electing standing committee chairs and the requirement of 10 members to form a negotiation group. <<> Fellow party lawmaker Choi Kyung-mi, before the processing of ordinances on the establishment of administrative bodies and the staffing of public officials, criticized the expansion of the organization and the increase in special-duty positions, stating, “Only political positions to assist the mayor are being drastically increased.” <<> Progressive Party lawmaker Shin Hyun-soon also demanded a deferral of deliberation and sufficient consideration regarding the ordinance on establishing the unified education office’s administrative body, arguing, “The organizational framework was decided in secret and hastily, without gathering opinions from the educational community.” <<> In the voting results, some contentious ordinances deviated from the trend of unanimous passage. The ordinance on the staffing of public officials passed with 75 in favor, 10 against, and 6 abstentions out of 91 members present. The ordinance on establishing the city education office’s administrative body was processed with 66 in favor and 15 against out of 81 members present. <<> Considering that minority party seats total only 8—5 for the Progressive Party, 2 for the Rebuilding Korea Party, and 1 for the People Power Party—the votes on the staff ordinance and the education office body ordinance suggest that some members of the Democratic Party also voted against them. While they remained silent in the open debate, the voting process revealed a critical undercurrent against the increase in special-duty positions and the design of the education office organization. <<> Progressive Party special city council member Park Hyung-dae said, “No matter how much rapid processing was needed on the first day of launch, reviewing ordinances is a core duty of the council. Failing to review them properly amounts to dereliction of duty.” He pointed out, “The Democratic Party seems to have focused only on forming the council leadership while neglecting the review of ordinances that will form the basic framework of the unified special city.” <<> In the Jeonju City Council of North Jeolla, there was also opposition from minority parties over the Democratic Party’s election of the council leadership. <<> On the 1st, the Jeonju City Council elected the leadership for the first half of its 13th term, marking its official launch. Of the 36 total seats, the Democratic Party holds 26. In the plenary session that day, Democratic Party four-term lawmaker Choi Joo-man was elected as chair, and three-term lawmaker Kim Dong-heon as vice-chair. <<> In his acceptance speech, Chair Choi stated, “I will create a council centered on its members, where communication and trust revive. I will respect all members regardless of party or seniority and faithfully fulfill the essential functions of checks and monitoring.” Vice-Chair Kim also said, “The Jeonju City Council will reduce unnecessary conflicts and faithfully carry out its role of checking the executive branch.” <<> However, the newly formed negotiation group, “Innovation Progressive Citizens’ Alliance,” which consists of 10 members—five from the Rebuilding Korea Party, one from the Progressive Party, and four independents—completely boycotted the vote for the leadership positions. <<> They held a press conference and criticized the Democratic Party, saying, “The Democratic Party ignored collaborative governance and unilaterally pushed through the formation of the leadership. This is an act of tyranny by the majority party and a disregard for the fundamental democratic principles of dialogue and compromise.” <<> The Innovation Progressive Citizens’ Alliance claimed, “All along, politics in Jeonju has seen the checks and monitoring functions paralyzed under the Democratic Party’s one-party monopoly system, and the city council has degenerated into a rubber stamp for the executive branch.” They further stated, “We will break the old practices of privilege and represent the voices of the citizens.” <<> Conflicts over the future operation of the council are also anticipated. The Innovation Progressive Citizens’ Alliance declared, “If the Democratic Party does not change its self-righteous attitude, we will not participate in the upcoming vote to elect standing committee chairs either. We will mobilize all available means to prevent the majority party’s dominance.” <<> While the Democratic Party maintains it will proceed with forming the council leadership as planned, the minority coalition’s announcement of action suggests trouble ahead in overall council operations, including the allocation of standing committees and the review of ordinances. <<> Across the Honam region, North Jeolla’s protest against the Gwangju/South Jeolla-centric semiconductor investment plan coincides with growing demands to check the Democratic Party’s one-party dominance structure within local councils. The Progressive Party and minority parties are raising issues of North Jeolla’s exclusion, the bundled processing of ordinances in the unified city council, and the monopoly of leadership seats in the Jeonju City Council, urging the Democratic Party not to turn its back on collaborative governance and its oversight role. (정부와 삼성전자, SK하이닉스가 발표한 ‘서남권 반도체 투자 계획’을 두고 전북 지역의 반발이 커지고 있다. 대규모 투자가 광주·전남에 집중되는 반면, 전북은 직접적인 산업 유치 효과에서 배제되고 송전망 부담만 떠안을 수 있다는 우려가 나오면서다.)

item.title: Among Democratic Party Supporters, Kim Min-seok Takes the Lead... In National Polls, Chung Cheong-rae Comes Out on Top (민주당 지지층선 1위 김민석... 국민 여론조사선 1위 정청래)
item.description:
Among Democratic Party Supporters, Kim Min-seok Takes the Lead... In National Polls, Chung Cheong-rae Comes Out on Top (민주당 지지층선 1위 김민석... 국민 여론조사선 1위 정청래)

Results released on the 1st showed that former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok received the highest support among Democratic Party supporters and the unaffiliated in a survey on the suitability for the next party leader of the Democratic Party of Korea. In a survey targeting the general public, former Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae ranked highest. (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 적합도 조사에서 김민석 전 국무총리가 민주당 지지층 및 무당층에서 가장 높은 지지를 받았다는 결과가 1일 나왔다. 일반 국민 대상으로 하는 조사에선 정청래 전 민주당 대표가 가장 높았다.)

According to a survey conducted by polling agency JoWon C&I on behalf of Straight News from the 27th to the 29th, targeting 1,064 Democratic Party supporters and unaffiliated individuals, when asked 'Who is the most suitable person to be the next Democratic Party leader?', former Prime Minister Kim recorded 36.3%. (여론조사 기관 조원씨앤아이가 스트레이트뉴스 의뢰로 지난 27~29일 민주당 지지층 및 무당층 1064명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, ‘차기 민주당 대표로 가장 적합한 인물이 누구인가’란 물음에 김 전 총리가 36.3%를 기록한 것으로 나타났다.)

Former leader Chung Cheong-rae followed with 29.5%, Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil with 14.2%, and Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-min with 3.4%. (정 전 대표가 29.5%로 그 뒤를 이었고 송영길 민주당 의원 14.2%, 김용민 민주당 의원 3.4% 순이었다.)

Democratic Party supporters and the unaffiliated are a group close to the actual voters in the Democratic Party's upcoming party convention next month. The Democratic Party has decided to elect its leader with 70% from party member voting and 30% from a public opinion survey. (민주당 지지층과 무당층은 다음 달 민주당 전당대회 실제 투표층에 가까운 집단이다. 민주당은 당원 투표 70%, 국민 여론조사 30%로 대표를 선출하기로 했다.)

In contrast, results from a survey of 2,000 general members of the public conducted during the same period showed that former leader Chung Cheong-rae was highest at 27.9%. Former Prime Minister Kim received 23.3%, lawmaker Song 11.0%, and lawmaker Kim 3.5%. (반면 같은 기간 일반 국민 2000명을 대상으로 한 조사 결과에선 정 전 대표가 27.9%로 가장 높았다. 김 전 총리는 23.3%, 송 의원은 11.0%, 김 의원은 3.5%였다.)

This survey was conducted using a wireless ARS method, with a sampling error of ±2.2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (이번 조사는 무선 ARS 방식으로 진행됐고 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±2.2%포인트다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Moon: "Party Unity First" vs. Lee: "Expanding the Base"... Subtle Temperature Difference at Cheong Wa Dae Lunch (文 “집안 단합” 李 “외연 확장”... 靑오찬서 미묘한 온도차)
item.description:
Moon: "Party Unity First" vs. Lee: "Expanding the Base"... Subtle Temperature Difference at Cheong Wa Dae Lunch (文 “집안 단합” 李 “외연 확장”... 靑오찬서 미묘한 온도차)

Former President Moon Jae-in and President Lee Jae-myung met on the 1st at Cheong Wa Dae's Sangchunje Pavilion, jointly voicing a message of 'unity'. However, they revealed subtle differences in their approaches and ultimate goals for achieving this. While both shared deep concern over the escalating factional strife within the Democratic Party of Korea ahead of its August party convention, former President Moon prioritized 'internal party consolidation through inclusiveness', whereas President Lee emphasized 'expanding the party's base centered on the administration'. (문재인 전 대통령과 이재명 대통령이 1일 청와대 상춘재에서 만나 한목소리로 ‘통합’을 외쳤다. 다만 이를 풀어 가는 해법과 지향점을 두고는 미묘한 시각차를 드러냈다. 두 사람은 8월 더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 계파 갈등의 과열 양상에 대해 깊은 우려를 공유하면서도, 문 전 대통령은 ‘포용을 통한 당내 결집’을, 이 대통령은 ‘정권 중심의 외연 확장’을 각각 우선순위로 꼽았다.)

◇ Moon: 'Party Unity First' vs. Lee: 'Expanding the Base' (◇ 文 ‘집안 단합이 먼저’ vs 李 ‘외연 확장’)

Former President Moon saw the starting point for unity as 'within the party'. He stated, "To move toward national unity, party unity must be the starting point," adding, "The Democratic Party must unite first, and then achieve greater unity with the democratic reform camp and the forces that participated in the revolution of light (Candlelight Revolution)." (문 전 대통령은 통합의 출발선을 ‘당 내부’로 뒀다. 문 전 대통령은 “국민 통합으로 나아가려면 역시 어떤 당내의 단합, 이게 이제 출발점”이라며 “민주당이 먼저 단합하고, 그 위에서 민주 개혁 진영, 그리고 빛의 혁명(촛불 혁명)을 함께했던 그런 세력들과의 더 큰 단합을 이루어내야 한다”고 했다.)

This is seen as an expression of concern that the non-Lee (anti-Lee Jae-myung) faction or the pro-Moon (pro-Moon Jae-in) faction might be sidelined ahead of the party convention. It is interpreted to mean that true unity is only possible by broadly encompassing the traditional mainstream forces that have formed the party's roots. (이는 전당대회를 앞두고 비명(비이재명)계나 친문(친문재인)계가 소외되는 걸 우려한 발언으로 보인다. 당의 뿌리를 형성해 온 전통적 주류 세력들을 전방위로 아울러야만 진정한 통합이 가능하다는 뜻으로 풀이된다.)

In contrast, President Lee placed more emphasis on the 'expansion of the party's base' rather than internal power dynamics. Lee said, "Our democratic government has now become a major force responsible for the entire nation," and added, "To ensure no one is worried, we all need to gather strength with those who share our vision, and based on that foundation, we will strive to expand toward achieving a structural majority." (반면 이 대통령은 당내 역학관계의 조율보다는 세력의 ‘외연적 팽창’에 무게를 실었다. 이 대통령은 “우리 민주 정부가 이제는 국가 전체를 책임져야 할 주요 세력이 됐다”며 “아무도 걱정하지 않도록 우리 모두 함께 뜻을 같이하는 사람들과 함께 힘을 모으고, 또 그 기반 위에서 우리가 구조적 다수를 향해서 좀 확장할 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

Underlying this is the sentiment that it is more urgent to broaden the base of supporters who 'share the vision' around the current mainstream faction, rather than focus on internal factional distribution, in order to form a 'structural majority' that secures an overwhelming advantage in the next presidential election and state affairs. (당내 계파 배분보다는 현재의 주류 세력을 중심으로 ‘뜻을 같이하는’ 지지층을 넓혀, 차기 대선과 국정 운영에서 압도적 우위를 점하는 ‘구조적 다수’를 형성하는 것이 더 시급하다는 정서가 깔려 있다.)

◇ Both Worried About Overheated August Party Convention (◇8월 전당대회 과열은 모두 우려)

Behind the repeated emphasis on 'unity' amidst the subtle temperature difference lies the uncontrollably heating factional strife ahead of the August party convention. As the emotional rift between the pro-Lee and pro-Jung (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) camps deepens, there is a widespread sense of crisis that the convention could become not a 'festival of the camp' but a 'mud-slinging fight of mutual destruction'. (두 사람이 미묘한 온도 차 속에서도 ‘단합’을 거듭 강조한 배경에는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 걷잡을 수 없이 과열되고 있는 계파 싸움이 자리 잡고 있다. 친명과 친청(친 정청래)의 감정적 골까지 깊어지면서 자칫 전당대회가 ‘진영의 축제’가 아닌 ‘공멸의 진흙탕 싸움’이 될 수 있다는 위기감이 팽배하다.)

To prevent internal strife from sapping the administration's momentum, former President Moon urged President Lee to "Become everyone's president with greater leadership," to which Lee replied, "Only with a solid core can we expand the base." (문 전 대통령은 내부 다툼으로 국정 동력이 상실되는 것을 막기 위해 이 대통령에게 “더 큰 리더십으로 모두의 대통령이 되어 달라”고 당부했고, 이 대통령 또한 “속이 단단해야 외연을 확장할 수 있다”고 했다.)

◇ Unanimous Praise for 'Honam Semiconductor Mega Project'... "Thanks to Renewable Energy Infrastructure" (◇‘호남 반도체 메가 프로젝트’ 두고 이구동성 찬사… “재생에너지 인프라 덕분”)

The two also found common ground on the 'Southwest (Honam) Semiconductor Mega Project,' which has emerged as a key national issue. Former President Moon congratulated, "I was truly delighted seeing the events in Gwangju and Jeonnam. The extensive construction of new and renewable energy wind and solar power facilities in the southwestern sea area during our administration served as the foundation, leading large-scale semiconductor projects and RE100 industrial complexes to go there." (두 사람은 최근 정국의 핵심 이슈로 부상한 ‘서남권(호남) 반도체 메가 프로젝트’를 두고도 공감대를 형성했다. 문 전 대통령이 “이번 광주·전남 행사를 보고 정말 기분이 좋았다. 우리 정부 때 서남해 지역에 신재생에너지 풍력과 태양광 발전을 많이 구축해 둔 것이 기반이 되어 대형 반도체 프로젝트와 RE100 산단이 그리로 가게 됐다”고 축하를 건넸다.)

In response, President Lee highlighted the previous administration's (Yoon Suk Yeol government) missteps while highly praising the Moon administration's energy legacy. Lee noted, "It is entirely thanks to President Moon's fostering of the renewable energy industry. Without that infrastructure, it would have been difficult to start anew. Although the previous government was hostile, suspicious, and even investigated the renewable energy industry, it is very fortunate that the achievements of the successive democratic governments have ultimately borne new fruit." (그러자 이 대통령은 전 정권(윤석열 정부)의 실책을 꼬집으며 문재인 정부의 에너지 유산을 높이 평가했다. 이 대통령은 “전적으로 문 대통령께서 재생에너지 산업을 육성해 놓으신 덕분이다. 그 인프라가 없었다면 새롭게 시작하기 어려웠을 것”이라며 “지난 정부에서 재생에너지 산업을 적대화하고 의심해 수사하는 등 박해했지만, 결국 이어져 온 민주 정부의 성과가 새로운 과실로 나타난 것 같아 참 다행스럽다”고 짚었다.)

◇ Lee: "During the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration, Many Achievements of the Moon Administration Were Damaged" (◇李 “윤석열 정부 때, 文 정부 성과 많이 훼손”)

President Lee reported, "It's been just over a year since I took office, and during this time, many achievements that President Moon made over five years have been damaged. Too much has been ruined, across diplomacy, security, inter-Korean relations, the economy, and culture. I am focusing on normalizing this." He added, "I've come to realize that what President Moon accomplished, along with what former Presidents Roh Moo-hyun and Kim Dae-jung created, are huge achievements that will be historically evaluated. One doesn't fully grasp this until they are heavily damaged. So I am continuously working hard to restore them." (이 대통령은 “제가 (집권한 지) 1년 남짓 됐는데, 그동안 (문재인 전) 대통령님께서 5년 동안 만든 성과가 많이 훼손됐다. 외교·안보·남북관계·경제·문화 할 것 없이 너무 많은 것들이 망가졌다”며 “이를 정상화하는 일에 주력하고 있다”고 전했다. 이어 “(문 전) 대통령께서 하신 일과, 노무현·김대중 전 대통령께서 만든 것들은 역사적으로 평가받을 큰 성과라는 생각을 하게 된다”며 “잘 못 느끼다가 많이 훼손되고 나니 느껴진다. 그래서 계속 열심히 복구하려고 노력 중”이라고 했다.)

Specifically on inter-Korean relations, Lee diagnosed, "What I felt while meeting foreign leaders and handling inter-Korean affairs is that the relationship is so damaged it seems irreparable. The hostility and confrontational mindset are not things that can be resolved with a year or two of effort or a change in stance." He further said, "Although investigation results are coming out, it seems the military pressure exerted on the North, allegedly for a military coup or a self-coup, was truly excessive. Too much damage has accumulated," while also stating, "However, the peace and coexistence policies for the two Koreas, such as the Sunshine Policy pursued by democratic governments, must be continued without pause. I will ensure they are carried forward well." (이 대통령은 특히 남북 관계와 관련, “해외 정상들을 만나고, 남북관계를 대하며 느낀 게 회복 불가능할 정도로 (남북관계가) 망가졌다는 생각이 든다. 적대감과 대결 의식이 한두 해 정성을 들이거나 입장을 바꿔서 해결될 수 없는 상황인 것 같다”고 진단했다. 또 “특히 지금 계속 (조사) 결과들이 나오긴 하지만 이 군사 쿠데타·친위 쿠데타를 위해 북쪽을 이 군사적으로 압박한 게 정말 너무 컸던 것 같다. 너무 많이 쌓여 있다”면서도 “민주 정부들이 해왔던 햇볕정책 등 남북 평화 공존 정책은 끊임없이 해야 한다. 잘 이어가도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, concerned about President Lee's health due to his heavy workload, former President Moon advised him to take a break, saying, "A president's health is not personal but a public asset." In a warm and cheerful response, President Lee brought up a pleasant anecdote about former President Moon's dental treatment during his time in office. After about 20 minutes of public dialogue, the two continued their discussion in private without any aides present. (한편 문 전 대통령은 격무에 시달리는 이 대통령의 건강을 염려하며 “대통령의 건강은 개인의 것이 아니라 공공재”라며 한숨 돌릴 것을 권했고, 이 대통령은 과거 문 전 대통령의 재임 시절 치과 치료 일화를 유쾌하게 꺼내 들며 화기애애하게 화답했다. 이날 20여 분간 공개 대화를 마친 두 사람은 배석자 없이 비공개 대화로 전환해 논의를 이어갔다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Holds Self-Reflection Forum on ‘Neglecting the 2030 Generation’... “Are We Only Going to Fight Over Supplementary Investigation Powers?” (민주당, ‘2030 외면’ 반성 토론회...“보완수사권 갖고만 싸울건가”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Holds Self-Reflection Forum on ‘Neglecting the 2030 Generation’... “Are We Only Going to Fight Over Supplementary Investigation Powers?” (민주당, ‘2030 외면’ 반성 토론회...“보완수사권 갖고만 싸울건가”)

For the Democratic Party of Korea to gain support from the 2030 generation, the critique emerged on the 1st that “the party must acknowledge it is part of the establishment and compete with competence.” (더불어민주당이 2030세대의 지지를 받기 위해서는 “민주당이 기득권임을 인정하고, 유능함으로 승부해야 한다”는 지적이 1일 나왔다.)

On this day, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Min-gyu hosted a forum titled “Why Don’t the 2030 Generation Support the Democratic Party? The Path the Democratic Party Must Take” at the National Assembly Members’ Office Building in Yeouido, Seoul. Also in attendance were National Assembly Deputy Speaker Nam In-soon, Policy Committee Chair Han Jung-ae, Chief Policy Secretary Kim Han-gyu, and lawmakers Park Ju-min and Lee Ju-hee. (이날 민주당 박민규 의원은 서울 여의도 국회 의원회관에서 ‘왜 2030은 민주당을 지지하지 않는가? 민주당이 가야할 길’ 토론회를 개최했다. 남인순 국회부의장, 한정애 정책위의장, 김한규 원내정책수석, 박주민·이주희 의원도 참석했다.)

At the event, Chair Han stated, “We deny it, but the Democratic Party is part of the establishment, yet we still seem to be in denial. We need to acknowledge that and move forward.” She further pointed out, “The reason the 2030 generation supported us in 2012 and 2017 was because that generation shared the experience of missing former President Roh Moo-hyun. Now, it’s no longer that. If we’ve seen three or four presidents come and go, we’re now in a situation where we have to compete with competence.” (이 자리에서 한 의장은 “우리는 아니라고 하지만 민주당은 기득권인데 여전히 부정하고 있는 것 같다. 그것을 인정하고 가야겠다”고 했다. 또 “그나마 2012년 2017년 2030이 우리를 지지했던 것은 그때의 2030 세대가 노무현 전 대통령을 일어버린 경험을 공유하는 세대였다. 이제는 그게 아니라 대통령을 세 번 네 번째 대출을 하는 정도면 이제는 그 유능함으로 승부를 해야 되는 상황”이라고도 지적했다.)

Criticism also emerged that despite repeated forums, nothing has changed. Chief Secretary Kim said, “After losing the 2021 by-elections, we held meetings and forums on the same topics, and five years have passed with little change from back then.” (거듭 토론회를 열어도 바뀐 것이 없다는 비판도 나왔다. 김 수석은 “2021년 재보궐 선거 지고 나서도 지금과 같은 주제로 회의하고 토론회도 하고 했었는데, 그때와 크게 달라진 건 없이 5년이 지났다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park, who served as the forum’s moderator, remarked, “The Democratic Party’s national convention is approaching. Under the member-centered system, the party leadership and supreme council members are elected through 70% member votes and 30% public opinion polls. Unfortunately, looking at the age composition of Democratic Party members, the proportion of the 2030 generation is underrepresented compared to their share of the overall population.” He added, “The key issue is how to bring the 2030 generation into the party and engage them in discussions.” (토론회 좌장을 맡은 박 의원은 “민주당 전당대회가 다가오고 있다. 당원 중심제에서 70%의 당원과 30%의 여론조사를 통해 당 지도부와 최고위원을 선출한다”며 “그런데 인타깝게도 민주당 당원의 연령대별 구성을 보면 2030세대의 비중은 전체 인구 비중에 비해 과소 포집되어 있다”고 했다. 또 “2030세대를 어떻게 당 안으로 끌어들일까, 의논에 참여시킬까 문제가 중요하다”고도 했다.)

Claims were also made that the policies and agendas currently proposed by the Democratic Party are disconnected from the 2030 generation. Kim Hyung-nam, co-representative of the political think tank Valide and a former candidate in the Democratic Party’s Seoul mayoral primary, said, “It’s time to decide whether we’ll spend our entire term fighting over who is truly sincere about abolishing supplementary investigation powers, or whether we’ll compete to show who can present the vision of the country 10 years from now that the Democratic Party will build.” He added, “Only then will the many people and young people who don’t turn out to vote come to the polls.” (현재 민주당이 제시하는 정책과 아젠다가 2030세대와는 동떨어진 것이라는 주장도 나왔다. 민주당 서울시장 경선 후보였던 김형남 정치 싱크탱크 밸리드 공동대표는 “임기 내내 보완수사권 폐지에 누가 진심인지 싸우다 시간을 보낼 것인지, 아니면 민주당이 만들 10년 뒤 국가의 모습을 누가 보여주는지 경쟁할지 이제 결정할 때”라고 했다. 또 “그래야 투표장으로 나오지 않는 다수의 사람들과 청년들이 나올 것”이라고도 했다.)

Professor Ahn Byung-jin of Kyung Hee University’s Institute for Future Civilization, who served on President Lee Jae-myung’s National Planning Committee, presented a discussion titled “10 Misconceptions of the Korean Democratic Party.” He said, “I’m a bit embarrassed, but what I found regrettable during the National Planning Committee was why people like me, in my 50s or older, had to lead it—I really couldn’t understand that.” He added, “Whether it’s any committee or any position within the party, I hope we can strongly elevate young people.” (이재명 대통령의 국정기획위원회에서 활동했던 안병진 경희대 미래문명원 교수는 ‘한국 민주당의 10가지 착각’이라는 제목으로 발제했다. 그는“저도 좀 부끄럽지만 국정기획위원회 때 아쉬웠던 점은 왜 국정기획위를 저 같은 50대 이상이 주도해야 되는지 저는 그게 잘 이해가 되지 않았다”고 했다. 그러면서 “어떤 위원회를 하든 정당에서 어떤 포지션을 하든 강력하게 청년들을 등장시키면 좋겠다”고도 했다.)

Regarding independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, Professor Ahn analyzed, “In this election phase, the most innovative and field-based excellent campaign was run by candidate Han Dong-hoon,” and added, “Oh Si-hoon was also underestimated by the existing Democratic and progressive camps due to past images and inertia.” (안 교수는 한동훈 무소속 후보를 향해 “이번 선거 국면에서 가장 혁신적이고 현장 기반의 탁월한 캠페인을 펼친 후보는 한동훈”이라며 “오시훈 역시 기존 민주, 진보 진영에서 과거 이미지와 관성으로 과소평가”했다고 분석했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Great Unity Within, External Expansion Without… The Path to Regime Renewal" (정청래 “안으로는 대통합, 밖으로는 외연 확장…정권 재창출의 길”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Great Unity Within, External Expansion Without… The Path to Regime Renewal" (정청래 “안으로는 대통합, 밖으로는 외연 확장…정권 재창출의 길”)

Former Representative Jung Cheong-rae, known to be running for reelection in the August Democratic Party leadership race, proposed on the 1st that the party should pursue "great unity within and external expansion without." Amid growing internal competition for party leadership, this is interpreted as an emphasis on consolidating the support base while uniting and allying with the broader democratic and progressive camp. (8월 더불어민주당 대표 선거에 출마해 연임에 도전할 것으로 알려진 정청래 전 대표가 1일 “안으로는 대통합, 밖으로는 외연 확장”을 민주당이 가야 할 길로 제시했다. 당권 도전을 둘러싸고 당내 경쟁 분위기가 고조되는 가운데, 지지층의 결집과 범민주진보 진영의 통합·연대를 함께 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Jung attended the inauguration ceremony of North Jeolla Province Governor Lee Won-taek held at the provincial office in the afternoon. He was accompanied by lawmakers including Choi Min-hee, Yoon Jun-byeong, Lee Seong-yoon, and Im O-kyeong. (정 전 대표는 이날 오후 전북도청에서 열린 이원택 전북도지사 취임식에 참석했다. 전북 방문에는 최민희·윤준병·이성윤·임오경 의원 등이 동행했다.)

Before the ceremony, Jung told reporters, "There were many difficulties in the last election. Yet, you helped elect many Democratic Party candidates, including the governor, 14 mayors and county heads, and provincial council members, so I came to express my gratitude." (정 전 대표는 취임식에 앞서 기자들과 만나 “지난 선거 때 많은 어려움이 있었다. 그런데도 도지사, 14개 시장·군수, 도의원 등 민주당 후보들을 많이 당선시켜 줘 감사 인사 차 왔다”고 말했다.)

Regarding public sentiment in North Jeolla, he said, "Before coming here, I visited Gunsan Daeya Market and Jeonju Jungang Market. The residents I met there seemed a bit disappointed. They said that this time, a lot has been invested mainly in Gwangju and South Jeolla, and asked what about North Jeolla." (그는 전북 민심과 관련해 “이곳에 오기 전 군산 대야시장과 전주 중앙시장에 들렀다”며 “시장에서 만난 도민들이 좀 서운하다고 하더라. 이번에 광주·전남에 주로 많은 것을 투자하고 전북은 뭐냐는 말씀이었다”고 전했다.)

This is seen as a remark reflecting local concerns that North Jeolla has been relatively sidelined in large-scale industrial investment plans announced by the government and businesses. Jung said, "I promised to do my utmost to ensure that North Jeolla doesn't feel left out, so that the Democratic Party can bring more investments, including in AI and physical AI." (정부와 기업이 발표한 대규모 산업 투자 계획에서 전북이 상대적으로 소외됐다는 지역 내 우려를 의식한 발언으로 해석된다. 정 전 대표는 “전북이 소외감 없도록 민주당에서 AI, 피지컬 AI 관련 등 더 많은 투자를 할 수 있도록 최선의 노력을 다하겠다고 약속드렸다”고 했다.)

He added, "The residents of North Jeolla have a great sense of loss. Regarding those issues, I will do my best so that the government and the Democratic Party pay close attention and provide significant help in the future." (이어 “전북도민들이 많은 상실감을 갖고 있다”며 “그런 부분에 대해 앞으로 정부와 민주당에서 신경을 많이 쓰고 크게 도움 될 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Jung also made a clear stance on internal party unity. He said, "Within the party, we must achieve a great unity where supporters of Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung come together as one." (정 전 대표는 당내 통합 문제에 대해서도 분명한 입장을 밝혔다. 그는 “당 안으로는 김대중·노무현·문재인·이재명 대통령 지지자들이 하나로 모이는 대통합을 이뤄야 한다”고 말했다.)

He added, "Externally, we must unify where we can and ally where we can to expand our reach further. This, I believe, is the path the Democratic Party must take to renew the regime." (그러면서 “밖으로는 통합할 것은 통합하고 연대할 것은 연대해서 외연을 더 확장하는 것, 이것이 정권 재창출을 위해 민주당이 걸어가야 할 길이라고 생각한다”고 밝혔다.)

Jung also posted a similar message on Facebook that day. He wrote, "You cannot cut off the roots and make the flowers bloom. We must nourish the history of Kim Dae-jung, the history of Roh Moo-hyun, and the history of Moon Jae-in to make the history of Lee Jae-myung bloom even more." (정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에서도 같은 취지의 메시지를 냈다. 그는 “뿌리를 자르고 꽃을 피울 수는 없다”며 “김대중의 역사, 노무현의 역사, 문재인의 역사를 자양분 삼아 이재명의 역사를 더욱 꽃피워야 한다”고 적었다.)

He continued, "For the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, victory in the general election, and regime renewal, we must achieve a great unity of supporters who backed those four presidents." (이어 “이재명 정부의 성공, 총선 승리, 정권 재창출을 위해서 네 분의 대통령을 지지했던 지지자들의 대통합을 이루어야 한다”고 했다.)

Jung also said, "We won when united and lost when divided. We must unify where we can and ally where we need to. Through unity and alliance, we must broaden the playing field." He added a separate note, "Within, a unity of four (presidential supporters); without, unity and alliance with the broad democratic-progressive camp." (정 전 대표는 또 “단결하면 승리했고 분열하면 패배했다”며 “통합할 곳은 통합하고 연대할 곳은 연대해야 한다. 통합과 연대로 운동장을 넓게 써야 한다”고 밝혔다. 그는 별도 문구로 “안으로는 4통 통합, 밖으로는 범민주진보 통합과 연대”라고도 했다.)

Jung's remarks on that day drew attention amid the phase of party leadership competition. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who stepped down as prime minister that day, took a direct jab at Jung in a media interview, saying, "It's hard to see the need or necessity for him to serve as leader twice, given the methods he has used so far." (이날 정 전 대표의 발언은 당권 경쟁 국면과 맞물려 주목을 받았다. 이날 총리직에서 물러난 김민석 총리는 이날 보도된 언론 인터뷰에서 정 전 대표를 향해 “지금까지 했던 방식으로 굳이 대표를 두 번 할 필요나 필요성을 발견하기 어렵다”고 직격했다.)

Jung also mentioned the meeting between President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in. He said, "I sincerely hope that today's meeting between President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in will revive the spirit of a dignified political party." (정 전 대표는 이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령의 만남도 언급했다. 그는 “오늘 이재명 대통령님과 문재인 전 대통령님의 만남에서 명문정당의 기풍이 다시 만들어지길 진심으로 기원한다”고 했다.)

Inside and outside the Democratic Party, how the next leadership will support the Lee Jae-myung administration while balancing party unity and external expansion has emerged as a key issue. On that day, Jung, at a site in North Jeolla, promised to address regional feelings of neglect while emphasizing within the party the consolidation of former presidents' supporters and externally the unity and alliance with the broad democratic-progressive camp, concretizing his message for the leadership race. (민주당 안팎에서는 차기 지도부가 이재명 정부를 뒷받침하면서도 당의 통합과 외연 확장을 어떻게 조율할지가 주요 쟁점으로 떠오르고 있다. 정 전 대표는 이날 전북 현장에서 지역 소외감 해소를 약속하는 한편, 당내로는 전직 대통령 지지층의 결집, 밖으로는 범민주진보 진영과의 통합·연대를 강조하며 당권 경쟁의 메시지를 구체화했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Unity, Expansion, and Results... I will take the words of the two presidents to heart" (송영길 “단합과 확장, 그리고 성과…두 대통령 말씀 무겁게 새기겠다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Unity, Expansion, and Results... I will take the words of the two presidents to heart" (송영길 “단합과 확장, 그리고 성과…두 대통령 말씀 무겁게 새기겠다”)

Rep. Song Young-gil, known to be running for leader of the Democratic Party of Korea in August, on the 1st emphasized "unity, expansion, and results" regarding the luncheon meeting between President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in. (8월 더불어민주당 당 대표 선거에 출마할 것으로 알려진 송영길 의원이 1일 이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령의 오찬 회동과 관련해 “단합과 확장, 그리고 성과”를 강조했다.)

On this day, Rep. Song posted on Facebook an article titled 'Unity, expansion, and results. I will take the words of the two presidents to heart' and stated, "I have confirmed the report on the luncheon between President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in." (송 의원은 이날 페이스북에 ‘단합과 확장, 그리고 성과. 두 분 대통령님의 말씀을 무겁게 새기겠습니다’라는 제목의 글을 올리고 “이재명 대통령님과 문재인 전 대통령님의 오찬 보도를 확인했다”고 밝혔다.)

He said, "The words of the two presidents, which resolve the issues we have been worried about. I am truly grateful." (그는 “그동안 우려하던 일들을 해소하는 두 분 대통령님의 말씀. 진심으로 감사하다”고 했다.)

Introducing President Lee's remarks, Rep. Song wrote, "President Lee Jae-myung emphasized that while 'one must be solid on the inside,' we must 'continuously expand our external reach and strive to create a structural majority, and that must be supported by results.'" (송 의원은 이 대통령의 발언을 소개하며 “이재명 대통령께서는 ‘속이 단단해야 한다’면서도 ‘끊임없이 외연을 확장하면서 구조적 다수를 만들기 위해 노력해야 하며, 성과를 통해 그것이 뒷받침돼야 한다’고 강조하셨다”고 적었다.)

He also conveyed former President Moon Jae-in's remarks. Rep. Song stated, "Former President Moon Jae-in also said that 'party unity is the starting point for national unity,' emphasizing that the Democratic Party must first unite and then achieve a greater unity with forces that joined the 'revolution of light' together on that foundation." (문 전 대통령의 발언도 함께 전했다. 그는 “문재인 전 대통령께서도 ‘당내의 단합이 국민 통합의 출발점’이라며, 민주당이 먼저 단합하고 그 위에서 빛의 혁명을 함께한 세력까지 더 큰 단합을 이뤄야 한다고 하셨다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding the messages from the two presidents, Rep. Song said, "Unity, expansion, and results. I deeply agree." (송 의원은 두 전·현직 대통령의 메시지에 대해 “단합과 확장, 그리고 성과. 깊이 공감한다”고 했다.)

He further stressed, "Our Democratic Party is the ruling party responsible for the entire Republic of Korea. Creating results through unity and expansion, and building a 'true ruling party' proven by those results—that is the way to answer the requests of the two presidents, I believe." (이어 “우리 민주당은 대한민국 전체를 책임지는 집권 여당”이라며 “단합과 확장으로 성과를 만들고, 그 성과로 증명하는 ‘진짜 여당’을 만드는 것. 그것이 두 분의 당부에 답하는 길이라고 믿는다”고 강조했다.)

Rep. Song also mentioned balanced regional development. He conveyed, "Former President Moon asked us to 'also take good care of regions that feel slighted,' while celebrating the achievements in balanced regional development." (지역균형발전에 대한 언급도 이어졌다. 송 의원은 “문 전 대통령께서 지역균형발전의 성과를 축하하시며 ‘서운하다는 지역까지 잘 아울러 달라’고 당부하셨다”고 전했다.)

He said, "I will add my strength so that the promise of a country where local talent doesn't have to leave for the capital for jobs continues unshaken." (그는 “지역 인재가 일자리 때문에 수도권으로 떠나지 않아도 되는 나라, 그 약속이 흔들림 없이 이어지도록 힘을 보태겠다”고 했다.)

At the end of his post, Rep. Song again mentioned "unity, expansion, and results" and stated, "I will take the will of the two presidents to heart and put it into practice." (송 의원은 글 말미에 다시 “단합과 확장, 그리고 성과”를 언급하며 “두 분 대통령님의 뜻을 무겁게 새기고 실천해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

On this day, Rep. Song's message focused on reflecting on the meaning of party unity, expanding external horizons, and governing results that emerged from the luncheon between President Lee and former President Moon. The intent is that the Democratic Party, as the ruling party, must solidify internal cohesion and, based on that, produce results that can win broader public support. Recently, in some ruling party circles, controversy arose when Yoo Si-min remarked about President Lee's governance of expanding external horizons, saying, "Wasn't his confidence a bit excessive?" and "It seems he tried to do a reconstruction rather than an expansion," among other comments. (이날 송 의원의 메시지는 이 대통령과 문 전 대통령의 오찬에서 나온 당내 단합, 외연 확장, 국정 성과의 의미를 되새기는 데 초점이 맞춰졌다. 민주당이 집권 여당으로서 내부 결속을 다지고, 이를 바탕으로 더 넓은 국민적 지지를 얻을 수 있는 성과를 내야 한다는 취지다. 최근 여권 일각에서는 유시민씨가 이 대통령의 외연 확장 국정 운영과 관련 “자신감이 지나치셨던 게 아닌가”, “증축이 아닌 재건축을 하려했던 것 같다”고 말하는 등 논란이 일기도 했다.)
